blocks.text: Comprehensive Eye Exams with Your Houston Eye Doctor
blocks.html: Comprehensive Eye Exams with Your Houston Eye Doctor

Protecting your vision starts with comprehensive eye exams in Houston tailored to your needs. Our experienced Houston optometrist uses advanced diagnostic technology to thoroughly assess your ocular health and vision. During every exam, we check for early signs of eye conditions such as glaucoma, cataracts, macular degeneration, and diabetic eye disease. By catching issues early, we can provide effective glaucoma treatment in Houston and management of other eye diseases to preserve your sight.

Every patient receives a personalized exam and clear explanations of the findings. Whether it’s your annual vision check-up or a specialized consultation, you’ll experience attentive care aimed at keeping your eyes healthy for life. After your exam, we’ll recommend the optimal solutions – from updated prescriptions to preventive treatments – so you can see clearly and comfortably.

blocks.text: Comfortable Contact Lens Fittings in Uptown Houston
blocks.html: Comfortable Contact Lens Fittings in Uptown Houston

If you prefer contact lenses, our team offers professional contact lens fittings to ensure you get the most comfortable and accurate vision correction. Contact lenses Houston patients need should fit right and suit their lifestyle – we take detailed measurements of your eyes and evaluate your tear film to find the perfect lenses for you. Whether you need daily disposables, multifocal contacts, or have a condition that requires specialty lenses, we have you covered.

New to contacts? We’ll patiently teach you how to insert, remove, and care for your lenses, so you feel confident. With a wide selection of quality contact lens options and Dr. Muldoon’s expertise in hard-to-fit contacts, you can enjoy crisp vision without glasses. Our goal is to make switching to contacts easy and successful for every patient.

blocks.text: Pediatric Eye Exams In Uptown Houston
blocks.html: Pediatric Eye Exams In Uptown Houston

Good vision is vital for children’s growth and learning. Our optometry practice provides friendly, pediatric eye exams in Houston to care for your little ones’ eyes from toddler years through teens. We create a fun, stress-free environment so kids feel at ease during their visit. From using kid-friendly eye charts to taking extra time to answer questions, we make sure both children and parents are comfortable throughout the exam.

Our doctor checks for vision issues early on – like nearsightedness, lazy eye, or focusing problems – that can impact school performance or development. If your child needs glasses, we’ll help find frames they love and that fit properly. For teens interested in contacts, we ensure they learn safe handling and care. At Briargrove Eye Center, we treat your family like our own, giving parents peace of mind that their child’s vision is in excellent hands.
Advanced Technology & Personalized Care

Experience modern eye care with a personal touch. At our Houston eye clinic, we invest in state-of-the-art diagnostic equipment to deliver the highest standard of care. From digital retinal imaging that captures detailed pictures of your eye health to visual field testing for detecting glaucoma, our advanced technology helps us diagnose issues with precision. This means more accurate prescriptions, early detection of problems, and effective treatments tailored to you.
